title: Hitmonlee's Repeated Kicks Stretch Its Legs
premise: Repeated kicking makes both of Hitmonlee’s legs stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
audiencePromise: See how repeated kicks stretch Hitmonlee’s legs to strike fleeing foes.
openLoop: Why would repeated kicks stretch both legs even longer?
payoff: Repeated kicks stretch both legs even longer, specifically to strike a fleeing foe.
engagementQuestion: Would you rather face the Kick Master or flee?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and playful. Stress repeatedly, both legs, and fleeing foe. Pause before the final choice.

scenes.headline: KICKS MAKE LEGS STRETCH
scenes.narration: Hitmonlee kicks repeatedly, then stretches to strike fleeing foes.
scenes.caption: REPEATED KICKS → STRETCHED LEGS

scenes.headline: SPRINGLIKE LEGS
scenes.narration: Its legs freely contract and stretch, using springlike limbs for kicks.
scenes.caption: CONTRACT • STRETCH • KICK

scenes.headline: BOTH LEGS GO LONGER
scenes.narration: But repeated kicking makes both legs stretch even longer.
scenes.caption: BOTH LEGS STRETCH LONGER

scenes.headline: A FLEEING FOE
scenes.narration: The reason is specific: it stretches to strike a fleeing foe.
scenes.caption: TARGET: A FLEEING FOE

scenes.headline: DISTANT FOES CAN BE HIT
scenes.narration: Its stretchy legs can hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
scenes.caption: DISTANT FOE → RISING KICK

scenes.headline: FLEE OR FACE IT?
scenes.narration: Would you rather face the Kick Master or flee?
scenes.caption: FLEE OR FACE THE KICK MASTER?
